title: successful behavior: a completed handoff releases the old slot only after the successor route is confirmed
fixture: tests/fixtures/swarm_v2/account-reconciliation.json: account fixture with cap 4; seat eng-1 mid handoff (generation 1 occupied, generation 2 reserved), seat eng-2 orphan reservation of a replaced execution, seat eng-3 working with a confirmed terminal loss, and stored runtime observations for supervisor exit, Pod Failed, Pod not found, Pod unreachable and Pod Running
fixture_clock: build() from tests/sv2_ctl02_cases.py patches time.time to the fixture clock and issues launch grants; FleetRegistry, AccountCapacity and AccountReconciler read the same list

state_assertions.before_confirmation: the account hash holds the retiring generation 1 row, the generation 2 reservation, the orphan reservation and the lost terminal row; reconcile keeps them all and reports handoff_unconfirmed and orphan_reservation
state_assertions.after_confirmation: once the successor occupies with a live registry record, reconcile releases only the retiring row; the successor row is generation 2 occupied
state_assertions.unconfirmed_successor: a successor reservation that expires is released and the old slot stays counted as handoff_unconfirmed
state_assertions.waiting_quota: a worker waiting on provider quota keeps its occupied slot and is not a discrepancy until its session closes
state_assertions.report: report() returns findings and writes neither account rows nor the discrepancy hash

repeat_assertion: the handoff test runs twice on independent fakeredis fixtures (first, second)
boundary_assertion: judgement reads only the account hash, the execution registry, fleet session records and stored runtime observations; a local-backend session is not reported as unaccounted

account_occupancy_discrepancies.dimension: swarm fixture, account fixture, per reconcile pass

cleanup: fakeredis per test; no live resource mutations
